function.name: get_current_time
function.description: Get the current date and time in a timezone.

function.name: calculator
function.description: Evaluate a math expression exactly. Supports + - * / // % **, parentheses, sqrt, abs, round, min, max, pi and e. Note: % is the remainder operator, not percent; write "17.5% of 2340" as "0.175 * 2340".

function.name: list_files
function.description: List the files and folders in the user's workspace folder.

path.description: Folder inside the workspace, relative to its root. Defaults to the root.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a text file from the user's workspace folder. Long files are truncated.

path.description: File path inside the workspace, relative to its root, e.g. "notes.txt".

function.name: web_search
function.description: Search the web (DuckDuckGo) and return titles, URLs and snippets.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Create a text file in the workspace, or overwrite it completely. Requires the user's approval; they may edit or reject it.

path.description: File path inside the workspace, e.g. "plans/week.md".

content.description: The full new content of the file.

function.name: append_to_file
function.description: Add text to the end of a file in the workspace (creates the file if missing). Requires the user's approval; they may edit or reject it.

path.description: File path inside the workspace, e.g. "notes.txt".

content.description: The text to add. It goes on a new line.

function.name: create_note
function.description: Save a new markdown note in the workspace notes/ folder. Requires the user's approval; they may edit or reject it.

title.description: Note title; also used for the file name.

function.name: send_message
function.description: Send an email on the user's behalf. (Simulated for now: saved to workspace/outbox/.) Requires the user's approval; they may edit or reject it.

function.name: delete_file
function.description: Delete a file from the workspace. Disabled: always refused.

path.description: File path inside the workspace.
